description: This file declares the class XCastImplementation which implements the IXCast interface and related functionalities for managing casting operations within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for initializing, handling application requests, and managing plugin state, as well as internal classes and event handling mechanisms.

classes.name: XCastImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the IXCast interface and plugin control logic, including event handling, plugin management, and internal job dispatching.

classes.description: Nested class representing a dispatchable job for handling cast-related events asynchronously.
